title: Chinese embassy accuses Filipino reporters, politicians of twisting facts

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Chinese Embassy in Manila on Saturday accused Filipino journalists and politicians of distorting facts and exaggerating tensions with Beijing, as it faced mounting criticism over Ambassador Jing Quan’s remarks about China’s ability to use force against the Philippines. “Some Philippine politicians and reporters have very limited comprehension about facts,” the embassy said in a Facebook post. “But they are good at exaggeration, taking things out of context, and creating hype,” it added. The embassy did not identify any journalists, politicians or news organizations, nor did it cite specific reports or statements to substantiate its accusations. In another […]...
